title: Mega Mawile Setup Balance
author: MegaHappyDragonite
raw: Mega Dragonite and Mega Mawile are Megas that work well together. Mawile beats MFroslass, MTtar, and Mfloette, which Mega Dnite struggles into. Mega Dnite beats Zardy. Alolan Ninetales is for the Garchomp mu where it ohkos it and also offers screens into any team. Sinistcha sets TR for mawile, helps into mega swampert, can can re-activate Dragonite's multiscale, and has redirection so Mawile can set up with Swords Dance. Scarf Basculegion helps with the fast mode and can sweep in the endgame when TR is down and for consistent damage. Incin is for intimidate help, fake out to help set tr , and for abit of chip damage.
